It also consists of global products and regional products, specifically for large markets including Europe, China and Latin America. Volkswagen AG annual report in 2022 reported that the best-selling model under the Volkswagen brand globally was the Tiguan , followed by the B-segment range of Polo , Virtus , Nivus and Taigo , and Passat/Magotan .
